“哎，现在新能源汽车不是特别火吗？咱们进去看看呗？”李月芽提议道。

吴姜抬眼看了看面前的4S店，不，按专业的叫法应该是问界用户中心。

吴姜有些犹豫，新能源的车他没有考虑过，完全是被层出不穷的事故新闻吓的了。

李月芽看他犹豫，上前拉住他的胳膊，拽着他就往里面走：“走吧，看看又不是非要买！”

李月芽一眼就看穿了他的心思，不等他开口拒绝，直接伸手挽住他的胳膊，半拽半拉地往店里带：“怕什么？看看又不是非要买，放心，我不逼你！”

两人刚走到店门口，一名穿着干净工装、面带温和笑意的年轻销售员就快步迎了上来，语气热情：“两位好，欢迎光临问界用户中心！我叫小林，请问二位是想了解咱们的车型吗？”

吴姜点了点头：“对，先随便看看，了解一下。”

“好的，这边请！”

吴姜和李月芽紧随在销售员的后面，听小林有条不紊地讲解着每款车的核心优势、配置亮点。

很快，两人被一辆展车吸引，打开车门，车内满满的科技感瞬间扑面而来。尤其是李月芽，眼神瞬间亮了，不管是大气的外观还是精致的内饰，都精准踩在她的审美点上。

小林适时上前介绍：“这是咱们的M9，也是目前最受欢迎的车型之一，不管是外观设计还是内饰配置，都很贴合年轻人的审美。而且现在国产新能源的技术现在已经很成熟了，不管是续航和性能，还有安全性，您完全不用操心。”

顿了顿，他又热情提议：“二位要是感兴趣，也可以去试驾一圈，亲自感受下车辆的操控和性能。”

吴姜本就被车内的科技感勾起了兴趣，一听能试驾，当即满口答应。

小林动作麻利，几分钟就办好了试驾手续。

吴姜坐进驾驶位，刚一上手，就感受到了，和平时开老妈的车子，完全不一样的驾驶体验。

越开越满意，吴姜忍不住深踩了下油门，瞬间感受到了堪比跑车的推背感，之后更是体验了一下无人驾驶的乐趣。

"Hey, aren't new energy vehicles very popular now? Let's go in and take a look?" Li Yueya suggested.

Wu Jiang raised his eyes and looked at the 4S store in front of him. No, according to the professional name, it should be Wenjie User Center.

Wu Jiang was a little hesitant. He had not considered new energy vehicles. He was completely frightened by the endless news of accidents.

Seeing his hesitation, Li Yueya stepped forward and grabbed his arm, dragging him inside: "Let's go, let's see if we don't have to buy it!"

Li Yueya saw through his mind at a glance. Without waiting for him to say no, she directly reached out to hold his arm and half-tugged him to the store: "What are you afraid of? Look, you don't have to buy it. Don't worry, I won't force you!"

As soon as the two of them walked to the door of the store, a young salesman wearing clean work clothes and a gentle smile came up to him quickly and said in a warm tone: "Hello, you two, welcome to the Wenjie User Center! My name is Xiaolin. Do you want to know about our models?"

Wu Jiang nodded: "Yes, let's take a casual look and understand it first."

"Okay, this way please!"

Wu Jiang and Li Yueya followed closely behind the salesman, listening to Xiao Lin explain the core advantages and configuration highlights of each car in an orderly manner.

Soon, the two were attracted by a show car. When they opened the door, they were immediately greeted by the full sense of technology in the car.Especially Li Yueya's eyes instantly brightened up. Whether it was the grand appearance or the exquisite interior, they all accurately followed her aesthetic point.

Xiaolin stepped forward at the right time and introduced: "This is our M9, and it is also one of the most popular models at present. Both the exterior design and interior configuration are very suitable for the aesthetics of young people. Moreover, the domestic new energy technology is now very mature. Whether it is battery life, performance, or safety, you don't have to worry at all."

After a pause, he enthusiastically suggested: "If you are interested, you can also go for a test drive and feel the vehicle's control and performance for yourself."

Wu Jiang was already interested in the technology in the car. When he heard that he could test drive it, he immediately agreed.

Xiaolin acted quickly and completed the test drive procedures in a few minutes.

Wu Jiang sat in the driver's seat, and as soon as he got started, he felt that it was a completely different driving experience than driving his mother's car.

The further he drove, the more satisfied he became. Wu Jiang couldn't help but step on the accelerator, and instantly felt the push-back feeling comparable to that of a sports car. Later, he even experienced the fun of driverless driving.
